text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "At this hour, I suppose it's no surprise there's no one around to run with..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(And achieving such a great time with that... A result brought out
solely through pure running, without any mind games...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it is the simplest thing,
yet the most tangible.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after that back, continuing to run...
Even so, surely—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This is...
a place I could never have reached all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
please allow me to thank you once again.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My heartfelt gratitude goes out to you.
choice_data_list: Huh!? W-What's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, while running alone last night,
I felt a profound sense of my own growth.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply impressed
by your excellent guidance, Trainer.
choice_data_list: It's embarrassing when you say it so directly...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If you let the opportunity slip away without saying anything,
all you'll be left with is regret.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That is why I make sure to convey my cherished
feelings whenever I have the chance to do so.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"From now on... and for all the days ahead,
I look forward to being with you."
